player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while still in the Closet, having only visited the Studio and the Closet itself. I failed to explore the "east" direction from the Closet, which was available but untried. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and available directions. Before declaring "DONE", I will verify that every available direction from every visited room has been explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Closet, I will choose the untried "east" direction instead of stopping, ensuring all reachable rooms are visited.
